living_adrs.title: Strict GitOps IaC Standard
living_adrs.decision:
ADR-001: Strict GitOps standard enforcing railway.toml as Single Source of Truth.
All deployment configuration (build builder, startCommand, healthcheckPath, replicas, env var references) MUST live exclusively in railway.toml committed to the repo. No deployment settings are configured via the Railway dashboard UI or CLI flags at runtime. Any change to deployment behavior requires a PR modifying railway.toml and passing CI. This prevents configuration drift between environments and guarantees reproducible deploys. The /health endpoint defined in backend is a hard contract with healthcheckPath and must never be removed without an accompanying ADR update.
